common_misconceptions: Assuming that an atypical or mild presentation rules out Dry eye syndrome (keratoconjunctivitis sicca) associated with Sjogren's syndrome.
Relying solely on a single normal laboratory value or imaging result to prematurely exclude pathology.
Equating temporary symptomatic relief with full resolution of the underlying condition without completing standard evaluation.
Misattributing symptoms exclusively to Blepharitis without completing a comprehensive diagnostic workup.
dangerous_errors: Failing to recognize red-flag features and delaying urgent escalation or emergency intervention.
Prematurely discharging or reassuring the patient before completing appropriate diagnostic assessment.
Initiating empirical treatment without considering major patient contraindications or drug interactions.

reference_soap.subjective:
Chief Complaint: gritty, burning sensation in both eyes worsening at the end of the day

62F presents with 6 months of bilateral eye burning, dryness, and foreign body sensation that worsens when reading, using the computer, or at the end of the day in dry, air-conditioned rooms.
reference_soap.objective: Complete vital signs and focused physical examination. Evaluate for pertinent signs.
reference_soap.assessment: Clinical presentation highly suggestive of Dry Eye Syndrome (Keratoconjunctivitis Sicca), associated with Sjogren's.
reference_soap.plan: Perform Schirmer testing and ocular-surface staining when indicated. Recommend preservative-free artificial tears, warm compresses, and nighttime lubricating ointment; consider punctal plugs for persistent symptoms. Arrange appropriate retinal screening for ongoing hydroxychloroquine use, and urgently assess pain, photophobia, or reduced vision.

must_ask.objective: Characterize the timing and triggers of dryness
must_ask.say: Does it get worse with reading, screen time, or by end of day?

must_ask.objective: Confirm the Sjogren's syndrome diagnosis and dry mouth
must_ask.say: Do you also have dry mouth or joint pain from your Sjogren's?

must_ask.objective: Ask about current medications affecting tear production
must_ask.say: Are you taking hydroxychloroquine or other medications regularly?
Do you spend a lot of time in air-conditioned or dry rooms?

must_ask.objective: Explain artificial tears and punctal plug options
must_ask.say: We'll start preservative-free artificial tears frequently, and can discuss punctal plugs if drops aren't enough.
